goal: Generalize the 'when a Dialog is focused, Chronicle shows the real Document' behavior beyond the Realm board to every board preset (Domain, IDE, Designer, Agent) -- Chuck's own confirmed expectation: Chronicle is one universal concept, not something Realm alone gets.
done_when: On the Domain board (and IDE, Designer, Agent), focusing a real Dialog in Nav renders that Dialog's actual Document (cover, Forward/Step, Points grouped into Paths) via the same DomainRealmStory component already used correctly on Realm -- not the generic per-object presence view (agent/journey/draft/etc.) that currently shows there instead

The existing per-object presence views (agent details, journey details, draft details, etc.) still render correctly when the focused subject is NOT a dialog -- this is additive to the dialog case, not a removal of the other views
The Realm board's existing behavior (already correct, shipped in realm-home-chronicle-routing) is unchanged
Manual check: on /d/ke3p?board=domain, with 'Becoming Together' focused, Chronicle shows the real Document, not Kip's agent-presence/session view

touch: apps/web/src/v0/boards/panels/UniversalViewPanel.tsx (the showRealmDocument gate, ~lines 314-338 -- generalize the boardId === 'realm' condition to apply whenever subject.kind === 'dialog', regardless of board)
do_not_touch: DomainRealmStory.tsx -- already correct, derives scope generically from selection.selectedDialogId, reuse as-is
The per-object presence views (KeeperPresence.tsx's AgentFocusPresence/JourneyFocusPresence/DraftFocusPresence/etc.) -- these stay exactly as they are for every non-dialog subject
Which of Strip/Cast Reel/Original visual treatment the Document uses -- separate Rendr decision, see docs/becoming-together-cast-strip-proposal.md, not part of this handoff

pattern_ref: UniversalViewPanel.tsx:316-322 currently computes `showRealmDocument = boardId === 'realm' && (subject.kind === 'domain' || 'dialog' || 'draft' || 'moment' || 'library')`. Drop the boardId==='realm' restriction (or narrow it to just `subject.kind === 'dialog'` universally, since that's the specific case Chuck confirmed he wants) so every board preset routes a focused Dialog to RealmHomeChronicle/DomainRealmStory the same way Realm already does. Verify this doesn't regress the realm-home-chronicle-routing fix's own isUserHome handling.

git.pr_title: feat: show the real Document in Chronicle on every board, not just Realm

context.phase: Fifth in today's sequence of live-testing follow-ons -- ships after stop-orphan-echo-sessions.
related_handoffs: realm-home-chronicle-routing (archived, shipped -- built this exact behavior for Realm only)
context.notes: Chuck's own words, confirmed explicitly when asked: Chronicle should show the Document whenever a Dialog is focused, on every board, not just Realm. This directly explains why viewing 'Becoming Together' on the Domain board showed Kip's agent-presence view (complete with a cross-domain session list) instead of the Document -- the showRealmDocument gate that was added for Realm's fix never got generalized to other boards. This is the single biggest lever for making 'the Document' feel like a real, consistent platform concept rather than a Realm-only special case.
